findings.title: Huge utilization value in Anthropic usage JSON crashes the app on every launch
findings.source: Response body of GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage: five_hour/seven_day/seven_day_opus.utilization, limits[].percent, extra_usage.utilization (AnthropicWireTypes.swift:42,71,100)
findings.description: The Anthropic decoder accepts any finite Double, e.g. 1e300, as a utilization percent. toSnapshot (AnthropicWireTypes.swift:145-149, 168-173, 185) and UsageWindow.init copy it without a range or finiteness clamp. VendorSnapshot.maxUtilization (UsageSnapshot.swift:71) and UsageStore aggregate compute (UsageStore.swift:379) then pass it to the menu-bar label, whose Int(Double) conversion traps when the value does not fit in Int.
findings.exploit_scenario: The usage endpoint returns {"five_hour":{"utilization":1e300}}. Decoding succeeds, CachedFetch writes the payload to the disk cache (CachedFetch.swift:34-36), and the menu-bar label renders Int(1e300.rounded()), which is a fatal trap. On relaunch the cached payload decodes the same way and crashes again until the cache expires or is removed. Stale fallback keeps serving it if the next fetch fails.
preconditions: Attacker controls the Anthropic usage API response (malicious or compromised vendor; TLS rules out an ordinary MITM)
Anthropic card is expanded (default) or a notification threshold fires
findings.impact: Denial of service of the local menu-bar app (repeated crash loop through the disk cache); stops monitoring of every vendor. No data exposure.
findings.fix: Sanitize at the wire-to-snapshot boundary. In toSnapshot, or centrally in UsageWindow.init, drop non-finite values and clamp to a sane range (e.g. 0...1000) before building UsageWindow. Optionally, in the UI use Int(exactly:) or a checked conversion instead of Int(Double).
findings.evidence: AppConfig.swift:199-203 flexibleDoubleIfPresent returns any decoded Double; UsageWindow.swift:15-23 stores it as-is; UsageSnapshot.swift:70-72 max(); MenuBarLabelView.swift:39-41 Int(percent.rounded()); NotificationService.swift:102 Int(window.utilizationPercent).
